fusions.name: Draw It Out
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it meets. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dregs
fusions.desc: Upends the shield, which deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 2 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Return
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Mithridate Lining
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 15% poison resistance.
